propositions: Mapping configuration must be read as a reserved section [tool.rebar.mapping] that bypasses unknown-key validation, similar to existing llm and snapshot sections
Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per-key across layers (built-in, default, project), allowing selective override while unnamed keys inherit
Vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale by most-specific layer, not union, so project-level declarations are authoritative-complete
Configuration validation must fail closed offline by rejecting axis-map values outside declared vocabulary, malformed blocks, and capability-absent axis references via a new MappingConfigError type
A provider-neutral Capability descriptor must gate each axis flag (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) without importing Jira adapter code
The core module (mapping_config.py) must remain provider-neutral, with vendors injecting only built-in defaults and capability flags through the adapter seam
